notes: New Settings window, laid out like the Claude app: pages on the left (General, Claude, Other AI providers, Research, Connectors, GitHub, Secrets), one page at a time on the right, and a search box. Changes save as you make them; the API key has its own Save button.
Connectors now live in Settings with two tabs: Yours (what you've added, with Test, Sign in and a ⋯ menu) and Discover (ready-made connectors, added with one click).

New Chrome connector: the AI can use your own Chrome, where you're already signed in, for example to make images in Gemini or ChatGPT. One-time step in Chrome: open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging and switch it on. There's also a separate Chrome window option where you sign in once.
